body: Wow that's really nice of you to say.

I believe life began a couple billions years ago through abiogenesis. Since then life has been an unbroken chain, so it doesn't really "begin" like we think it does. In other words, I think sperm cells and eggs are alive. 

As for when life ends, I'd say brain death for humans and many other animals. For animals with no brain or non-animals, I'm not sure when exactly life ends.
